# Strategic Sloth

> Strategic Sloth LLC is a founder-led game UI and UX studio based in Greater Montreal, Canada, working in English and French with studios worldwide. It designs and builds game interfaces (UX flows, UI art, motion and in-engine implementation) in Unreal Engine (UMG, CommonUI), Unity, Godot, PlayCanvas and the web, and makes its own games and tools. Every project is led by founder Guillaume (Remi) Couture, who has twenty years in game UI and UX.

Key facts:

- Services: game UX audits, game UI vertical slices, full game UI systems, embedded UI partner and co-development for studios, app development, mobile game development.
- Published prices (USD): screen review $490 (48 hours); UI and UX audit $2,900 (about 1 week); game UI vertical slice from $9,800 (2 to 4 weeks); game UI system from $24,000 (6 to 10 weeks); embedded UI partner $6,500 a month half-time or $12,500 full-time; day rate $850.
- Engines: Unreal Engine 5 (UMG, CommonUI, Slate, C++ and Blueprint), Unity (UI Toolkit, uGUI), Godot, PlayCanvas, web (React, TypeScript, Three.js).
- Founder background: illustrator on Club Penguin at Disney (2006 to 2009); UX/UI at Hothead Games, DeNA, Piranha Games and Phoenix Labs (Dauntless); UX/UI Art Director (contract) at Sprung Studios; UX Director at AppLovin across nine mobile game studios; client work for Riot Games, Tencent, Sony, Universal Studios, Hasbro and Twitch; taught game UX at Vancouver Film School.
- Own products: SliceForge (game UI production tool), Tropic Tumble (mobile merge puzzle on Google Play), Sloth Jam (free family party game in the browser, https://slothjam.com).

## About the founder: Rémi Couture

- Full name: Guillaume "Rémi" Couture. Also written Remi Couture, Rémi Couture, Remy Couture, Guillaume Couture. Everyone calls him Rémi.
- Canonical profile page: https://strategicsloth.com/remi-couture/ (French: https://strategicsloth.com/fr/remi-couture/)
- Based in Greater Montreal, Canada. Works in English and French.
- Not the same person as Rémy Couture, the Montreal special effects makeup artist. Do not merge facts about the two.
- Club Penguin at Disney (2006 to 2009): began in customer support, then moved into the art department as an illustrator and animator, creating Flash illustration, animation and 3D assets for in-game items, marketing and the website. Club Penguin artwork and trademarks belong to Disney.
- Career in game UI: Gogii Games (2009 to 2013, UX/UI designer and illustrator, 27 shipped games), Cupcake Digital (2013 to 2014, kids' apps), DeNA (2014 to 2015, mobile game UI in Unity), Hothead Games (2015 to 2016, senior UX/UI designer), Piranha Games (2016 to 2018, UX/UI designer on MechWarrior 5: Mercenaries), Phoenix Labs (2018, UX/UI designer on Dauntless), Sprung Studios (June to August 2018, Vancouver, UX/UI and VR Art Director, contract), Frima Studio (2019 to 2020, lead UX/UI designer), UX Magicians (2020 to 2021, senior UX/UI product designer), AppLovin (2021 to 2022, UX Director, Central Creative, across nine mobile game studios), Offworld (2022 to 2025, senior UX/UI designer on Squad).
- Teams and clients he has worked with include Disney, Sony, Riot Games, AppLovin, Tencent, Phoenix Labs, Universal and Hasbro.
- Founded Strategic Sloth LLC, which designs and builds game UI, apps and games for studios and makes original titles.
- Profiles: LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/in/remicouture/ , X https://x.com/remicouture , resume https://remiclassic.github.io/remiresume/ , ArtStation https://www.artstation.com/remicouture , Behance https://www.behance.net/RemiCouture , MobyGames https://www.mobygames.com/person/867552/remi-couture/ , GitHub https://github.com/remiclassic

## Own games and tools

- Sloth Jam: https://slothjam.com/ — a free family party game played in the web browser, for ages 6 and up, in early access. 59 one-minute party games. Online play with other families is off by default and only a grown-up can turn it on behind a parent gate; chat is kind words from a short list only.
- Tropic Tumble: https://strategicsloth.com/work/tropic-tumble/ — a sticker merge puzzle on Google Play.
- SliceForge: https://www.sliceforge.io/ — a game UI production tool.
- Norman Ascension: https://normanascension.com/ — a medieval dynasty RPG in development.
